definitions.explanation: A building or hall dedicated to the worship of a deity or deities. Used for both foreign temples (Greek, Egyptian, etc.) and the main hall of a Shinto shrine.

examples.japanese: ⟦ギリシャ→ギリシャ：28897_girisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{神殿|しんでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れた→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧エジプト⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{神殿|しんでん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発掘|はっくつ}→発掘：07995_hakkutsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An ancient Egyptian temple was excavated.

examples.japanese: {神殿|しんでん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{柱|はしら}→柱：05009_hashira⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{彫刻|ちょうこく}→彫刻：04448_choukoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{施|ほどこ}されていた→施す：12985_hodokosu⟧。
examples.english: The columns of the temple were adorned with beautiful carvings.

notes:
{神殿|しんでん} refers to a building dedicated to enshrining or worshipping a deity. It covers both foreign temples and the sacred inner buildings of Shinto shrines.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- パルテノン{神殿|しんでん}: the Parthenon
- ルクソール{神殿|しんでん}: Luxor Temple
- ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{神殿|しんでん}: the sacred hall of a Shinto shrine

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧: Shinto shrine (the whole complex)
- ⟦{本殿|ほんでん}→本殿：13090_honden⟧: main hall of a shrine (where the deity resides)
- ⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧/⟦{寺院|じいん}→寺院：00122_jiin⟧: Buddhist temple
- ⟦{教会|きょうかい}→教会：01387_kyoukai⟧: church

USAGE:
For ancient foreign temples (Greek, Egyptian, Roman), {神殿|しんでん} is the standard translation. In a Shinto context, it refers specifically to the innermost building where the deity is enshrined, not the shrine grounds as a whole.
